company.name: World View Enterprises
company.shortDescription: World View is a stratospheric exploration company delivering remote sensing and space tourism from the stratosphere.
company.description:
At World View® Enterprises, Inc. we are pioneering a new frontier at the edge of space: the stratospheric economy. Over 115 successful stratospheric flights and 10,274,598 vertical feet flown (Nov 2022), World View has innovated exploration of the stratosphere through advanced research, discovery, and now human spaceflight. We have engineered and patented sophisticated takeoff and landing systems and developed complex methodologies for controlling trajectories in the stratosphere. These innovations have earned us the trust of NASA and other government, scientific, and aerospace organizations. Our expertise enables us to bring edge-of-space travel to the public and stratospheric remote sensing to governments and businesses, as World View embarks on the mission to inspire, create, and explore new perspectives for a radically improved future.

We are on a mission to inspire, create and explore new perspectives for a radically-improved future. Whether though our remote sensing vehicles called Stratollites® that can persist in the stratosphere over areas of interest for months at a time, or our space tourism and exploration services that are introducing meaningful space tourism to entirely new addressable market, World View is delivering the first purpose-first service offering from the stratosphere.

aiResearchSummary.text: World View Enterprises is researching high altitude lighter than air balloon systems and methods, including super pressure and zero pressure balloon architectures, near space operation systems for safe manned and unmanned flights, and magnetic ballast dispenser systems to manage lift. They also develop deployable landing gear systems, high altitude parafoils, and valve for airbag decelerator technologies. Together these efforts target balloon platforms, flight control, and recovery systems.
